text: Division A Compliance, Objectives and Functional Statements
label: Division

text: Part 1 Compliance
label: Part

text: Section 1.1. General
label: Section

text: 1.1.1. Application of this Code
label: Subsection

text: 1.1.1.1. Application of this Code
label: Article

text: 1) This Code applies to any one or more of the following:
label: Sentence

text: a) the design and construction of a new building ,
label: Clause

text: b) the occupancy of any building ,
label: Clause

text: c) a change in occupancy of any building ,
label: Clause

text: d) an alteration of any building ,
label: Clause

text: e) an addition to any building ,
label: Clause

text: f) the demolition of any building ,
label: Clause

text: g) the reconstruction of any building that has been damaged by fire, earthquake or other cause,
label: Clause

text: h) the correction of an unsafe condition in or about any building ,
label: Clause

text: i) all parts of any building that are affected by a change in occupancy ,
label: Clause

text: j) the work necessary to ensure safety in parts of a building
label: Clause

text: i) that remain after a demolition,
label: Subclause

text: ii) that are affected by but that are not directly involved in alterations , or
label: Subclause

text: iii) that are affected by but not directly involved in additions,
label: Subclause

text: k) except as permitted by the British Columbia Fire Code, the installation, replacement, or alteration of materials or equipment regulated by this Code,
label: Clause

text: l) the work necessary to ensure safety in a relocated building during and after relocation,
label: Clause

text: m) safety during construction of a building , including protection of the public,
label: Clause

text: n) the design, installation, extension, alteration , renewal or repair of plumbing systems , and
label: Clause

text: o) the alteration , rehabilitation and change of occupancy of heritage buildings .
label: Clause

text: 2) This Code does not apply to the following:
label: Sentence

text: a) sewage , water, electrical, telephone, rail or similar public infrastructure systems located in a street or a public transit right of way,
label: Clause

text: b) utility towers and poles, and television, radio and other communication aerials and towers, except for loads resulting from their being located on or attached to buildings ,
label: Clause

text: c) mechanical or other equipment and appliances not specifically regulated in these regulations,
label: Clause

text: d) flood control and hydro electric dams and structures,
label: Clause

text: e) accessory buildings less than 10 m 2  in building area that do not create a hazard,
label: Clause

text: f) with the permission of the authority having jurisdiction , temporary buildings including
label: Clause

text: i) construction site offices,
label: Subclause

text: ii) seasonal storage buildings ,
label: Subclause

text: iii) special events facilities,
label: Subclause

text: iv) emergency facilities, and
label: Subclause

text: v) similar structures,
label: Subclause

text: g) factory built housing and components complying with CSA-Z240 MH Series standard, but this exemption does not extend to on site preparations (siting, foundations, mountings), connection to services and installation of appliances , and
label: Clause

text: h) areas that are specifically exempted from provincial building regulations by provincial or federal enactments.
label: Clause

text: 3) This Code applies to both site-built and factory-constructed buildings . (See Note A-1.1.1.1.(3).)
label: Sentence

text: 4) Farm buildings shall conform to the requirements in the National Farm Building Code of Canada 1995.
label: Sentence

text: 5) For heritage buildings , the Alternate Compliance Methods for Heritage Buildings in Table 1.1.1.1.(5) may be substituted for requirements contained elsewhere in this Code. (See Note A-1.1.1.1.(5).)
label: Sentence

text: 6) For the design and construction of alterations to existing buildings to add a secondary suite , not including the design and construction of new additions or new buildings , the Alternate Compliance Methods for Alterations to Existing Buildings to Add a Secondary Suite in Table 1.1.1.1.(6) may be substituted for requirements contained elsewhere in this Code. (See Note A-1.1.1.1.(6).)
label: Sentence

text: 1.1.1.2. Application to Existing Buildings
label: Article

text: 1) Where a building is altered, rehabilitated, renovated or repaired, or there is a change in occupancy , the level of life safety and building performance shall not be decreased below a level that already exists. (See Note A-1.1.1.2.(1).)
label: Sentence

text: 1.1.2. Internal References to this Code
label: Subsection

text: 1.1.2.1. Book I (General) and Book II (Plumbing Systems) of the Code
label: Article

text: 1) This is the first of the two Books, Book I (General) and Book II (Plumbing Systems), that together form the British Columbia Building Code.
label: Sentence

text: 1.1.2.2. Internal References to the Code
label: Article

text: 1) Unless a Book is specified, references to “the British Columbia Building Code,” “the Code,” “this Code” and the like shall be read as references to the Book in which they appear.
label: Sentence

text: 1.1.3. Appendices, Notes and Annotations
label: Subsection

text: 1.1.3.1. Appendices, Notes and References to Appendices and Notes have No Legal Effect
label: Article

text: 1) Except for Notes A-Table 9.23.3.5.-B and A-9.23.13., including Table A-9.23.13. in Division B, Notes to Parts of this Code have no legal effect.
label: Sentence

text: Section 1.2. Compliance
label: Section

text: 1.2.1. Compliance with this Code
label: Subsection

text: 1.2.1.1. Compliance with this Code
label: Article

text: 1) Compliance with this Code shall be achieved by
label: Sentence

text: a) complying with the applicable acceptable solutions in Division B (see Note A-1.2.1.1.(1)(a)), or
label: Clause

text: b) except as required by Sentence (3), using alternative solutions, accepted by the authority having jurisdiction under Section 2.3 of Division C, that will achieve at least the minimum level of performance required by Division B in the areas defined by the objectives and functional statements attributed to the applicable acceptable solutions (see Note A-1.2.1.1.(1)(b)).
label: Clause

text: 2) For the purposes of compliance with this Code as required in Clause
label: Sentence

text: 1.2.1.1.(1)(b), the objectives and functional statements attributed to the acceptable solutions in Division B shall be the objectives and functional statements referred to in Subsection 1.1.2. of Division B.
label: Article

text: 3) An alternative solution shall not be used in place of an acceptable solution if the acceptable solution expressly requires conformance to a provincial enactment other than Book I (General) or Book II (Plumbing Systems) of the British Columbia Building Code.
label: Sentence

text: 1.2.1.2. Responsibility of Owner
label: Article

text: 1) Unless otherwise specified in this Code, the owner of a building shall be the person responsible for carrying out the provisions of this Code in relation to that building .
label: Sentence

text: 2) The owner of a building is in no way relieved of full responsibility for complying with this Code by the authority having jurisdiction
label: Sentence

text: a) granting a building permit,
label: Clause

text: b) approving drawings or specifications, or
label: Clause

text: c) carrying out inspections.
label: Clause

text: 1.2.2. Materials, Appliances, Systems and Equipment
label: Subsection

text: 1.2.2.1. Characteristics of Materials, Appliances, Systems and Equipment
label: Article

text: 1) All materials, appliances , systems and equipment installed to meet the requirements of this Code shall possess the necessary characteristics to perform their intended functions when installed in a building .
label: Sentence
